text:
sarah: quick preflight — planning a 02:00 UTC tiny change window tonight to push runtime kernel tweak + router header flag. target: canary 5% then ramp to 20%. need signoff from api + console + router owners.
alex: ack. are we pinning the api proxy to v2.3.1 or leaving it unpinned? runtime needs the header shape to match.
mike: prefer pin for this release (api v2.3.1) — prevents mid-window mismatch. i can handle the pin if ops gives the go.
julie: console: will add a canary dashboard tile for per-route latency and request-q. i'll set an alert at 2x baseline and a 5m burn-in.
sarah: deploy-bot, config for canary: 5% for 10m, health check threshold 3/5 failures -> auto-rollback. also enable extra logging for kv-evictions.
deploy-bot: Canary started -> id=cb-1798501234, targets: api=5%, runtime=5%, router=5% (monitoring window 10m)
alex: note: runtime KV cache TTL reduction included in this tweak — expect a small eviction spike. set eviction logging to debug for 30m post-deploy.
mike: i'll draft release-notes summary: "pin api proxy to v2.3.1; runtime kernel micro-op improvement; router header opt-in flag; console canary panel". include rollback steps and known-issues.
julie: rollback checklist validated: 1) unpin api proxy -> v2.3.0, 2) disable router header flag, 3) trigger runtime canary rollback. rollback command below for ops:
```
./deploy rollback --canary cb-1798501234 --components runtime,router,api
```
sarah: ops, any capacity concerns for 02:00 UTC in eu-west-1? tagging @ops for final headcount.
ops: eu-west-1 GPU pool has ~20% spare headroom, autoscale enabled. no capacity blockers. monitoring slack alerting is green.
alex: created pin PR (api-proxy@v2.3.1) and added @mike as reviewer. will wait for merge before the canary.
mike: merged the pin PR and updated deploy-bot labels (permission: deploy/approved).
sarah: final checklist i'm pasting in the deploy doc and will open the window at 01:50 UTC: 1) dashboard up, 2) pin merged, 3) ops green, 4) rollback command available, 5) alerts configured. post here if anything changes. :thumbsup:
